decisions.reason: The source replaces the delivered video resource but does not change the candidate's measurement sequence, and no video-resource attribute exists in its current state.
Changing the external video's resource URL does not alter the existing iOS strategy of streaming the video rather than bundling it.
The video resource change does not modify Android localization coverage, language count, or full-app scope.
The video resource change does not modify iOS localization coverage, language selection, or full-app scope.
The supplied application-integration video resource is not identified as a social-media link and does not change the requirement that social-media links resolve.
The source does not identify the video resource as a localized social-media link or change social-media-link localization coverage.
The source changes only the external video resource; it does not change Android size goals or establish a new package-size optimization strategy.
The video resource change has no effect on Android permission policy or the removal of READ_PHONE_STATE.
Providing a different video resource does not change the iOS modernization or deprecated-API requirements.
The video resource change does not affect the requirement to provide an iOS Privacy Manifest.
The video resource change does not affect iOS signing certificates or submission signing configuration.
The source changes a video resource and does not alter right-to-left layout behavior or locale scope.
